decisions.rationale: Lead Farigiraf + Heliolisk pressures Mega Charizard Y immediately with Armor Tail blocking priority and Helping Hand Solar Power Thunderbolt. Camerupt is the Trick Room win condition into Excadrill, Scizor, and Mamoswine; Floette provides the reliable Rotom-Wash and Dark/Ice matchup.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 preview plan: lead Farigiraf + Heliolisk. Primary opening line versus Charizard Y is Helping Hand + Thunderbolt; Armor Tail prevents Weavile/Mamoswine/Scizor priority disruption. Keep Trick Room available to enable Mega Camerupt versus Excadrill, Scizor, and Mamoswine. Floette is the preferred fourth for Rotom-Wash and Dark/Ice pressure; Mega choice should usually be Camerupt after Trick Room, but reassess if Rotom-Wash is positioned to dominate.

decisions.rationale: Charizard leads to set Drought via Mega-Y for Fire Blast OHKOs on Fairy targets; Excadrill with Focus Sash guarantees a revenge-kill anchor with Mold Breaker EQ. Weavile and Scizor on bench supply two priority users (Ice Shard, Bullet Punch) to maintain speed control under Farigiraf Trick Room and clean up weakened foes.
decisions.notebook: Sun team plan: Mega Charizard Y Drought powers Fire Blast for Fairy OHKOs. Excadrill Focus Sash + Mold Breaker EQ revenge-kills Mega Camerupt/Mawile. Priority trio (Weavile Ice Shard, Scizor Bullet Punch, Mamoswine Ice Shard) covers Trick Room. Rotom-Wash pivots with Volt Switch and threatens with Hydro Pump. Mamoswine Thick Fat patches Ice weakness. Opponent Trick Room from Farigiraf is the primary disruption threat—priority users are the answer.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand makes Thunderbolt a guaranteed OHKO on Mega Charizard Y even through its full legal bulk range, while Armor Tail blocks opposing priority disruption. Removing Charizard immediately preserves Heliolisk’s Focus Sash versus Excadrill.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Helping Hand + Heliolisk Thunderbolt is a guaranteed OHKO on Mega Charizard Y under sun across legal bulk. Continue to preserve Farigiraf for Armor Tail and Trick Room; Mega Camerupt is the usual Trick Room payoff against Steel/Ground cores. Floette remains valuable versus Rotom-Wash and Dark/Ice pressure.

decisions.rationale: Mega Charizard Y to set Drought and OHKO Farigiraf with sun-boosted Fire Blast (2x super effective), removing Trick Room threat immediately. Excadrill Protects to safely scout with Focus Sash and preserve Mold Breaker EQ for revenge-killing next turn.

Weavile outspeeds both foes (Speed 194 vs Heliolisk 141–177) and brings Ice Shard priority to answer Trick Room, the primary threat. In active Sun it keeps offensive pressure while Excadrill is preserved. Excadrill passes to avoid a second Protect with reduced success rate.
decisions.notebook: Sun team plan intact. Priority trio (Weavile Ice Shard, Scizor Bullet Punch) is the answer to Farigiraf Trick Room. Excadrill Focus Sash + Mold Breaker EQ set to revenge-kill Mega Camerupt/Mawile. Rotom-Wash and Mamoswine still to be revealed. Drought 5 turns remaining.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf cannot reliably establish Trick Room into Weavile Knock Off plus Excadrill pressure. Preserve it for a later safe Trick Room; bring Camerupt in to threaten the Steel core while Protect guarantees Heliolisk avoids an Earthquake/Weavile double-target line this turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 plan: preserve Farigiraf for Armor Tail and a safer Trick Room window; Mega Camerupt is the primary Trick Room payoff versus Excadrill and likely Steel cores. Heliolisk’s Helping Hand-boosted Thunderbolt cleanly removed Mega Charizard Y under sun. Weavile carries Life Orb Knock Off/Night Slash and can potentially OHKO Farigiraf with Knock Off while its item remains. Excadrill is Jolly Focus Sash Mold Breaker with Earthquake, Iron Head, Rock Slide, Protect; its Protect has already been used once. Opponent’s final brought Pokémon is one of Scizor, Rotom-Wash, or Mamoswine. Floette is valuable against Dark/Ice pressure and Rotom-Wash.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Ice Shard on Farigiraf at +1 priority prevents Trick Room activation and chips it; Earthquake would drop Weavile to ~30% via friendly fire, so Excadrill switches to Scizor to set up the double-priority combo (Ice Shard + Bullet Punch) next turn for a reliable Farigiraf KO.
decisions.notebook: Sun team plan intact. Priority trio: Weavile Ice Shard, Scizor Bullet Punch, third priority TBD. Excadrill Focus Sash + Mold Breaker EQ reserved for revenge-killing Mega Camerupt/Mawile once they appear. Rotom-Wash and Mamoswine still to be revealed. Drought 4 turns remain after this turn.

decisions.rationale: Protecting Mega Camerupt denies Excadrill’s otherwise guaranteed Earthquake KO while preserving the key endgame win condition. Thunderbolt is Heliolisk’s only meaningful immediate pressure and has a possible KO on Weavile; Electroweb is weaker and does nothing to Excadrill.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Charizard-Y was removed by Helping Hand Solar Power Thunderbolt. Sun was established by Charizard-Y. Opponent revealed Weavile: Jolly Life Orb Pressure, Ice Shard/Night Slash/Knock Off/Icicle Crash; Knock Off guarantees Heliolisk KO from damaged health and threatens Psychic-types. Excadrill: Jolly Focus Sash Mold Breaker, Earthquake/Iron Head/Rock Slide/Protect; Earthquake guarantees KO on damaged Camerupt and Heliolisk. Excadrill successfully Protected once, then attempted and failed Protect on the following turn. Their final brought Pokémon is exactly one of Scizor (Expert Belt), Rotom-Wash (Leftovers), or Mamoswine (Focus Band). Preserve Armor Tail/Trick Room options where possible; Mega Camerupt is the primary slow-mode payoff, while Floette is important into Dark/Ice and potential Rotom-Wash.

decisions.rationale: Bring Farigiraf: Armor Tail shuts off the opponent’s revealed and potential priority, and Trick Room is the strongest route to regain control for Mega Camerupt if it survives. Floette is valuable later for Rotom-Wash coverage.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 reveals: Charizard-Y was removed by Helping Hand Solar Power Thunderbolt; it established sun. Weavile is Jolly Life Orb Pressure with Ice Shard/Night Slash/Knock Off/Icicle Crash. Excadrill is Jolly Focus Sash Mold Breaker with Earthquake/Iron Head/Rock Slide/Protect; it used Protect successfully once, then failed its consecutive attempt. Final opponent bring is exactly one of Scizor (Expert Belt), Rotom-Wash (Leftovers), or Mamoswine (Focus Band). Preserve Armor Tail to deny Bullet Punch/Ice Shard and seek Trick Room positioning for Mega Camerupt. Floette is especially important versus possible Rotom-Wash via Energy Ball and can support with Helping Hand.

decisions.rationale: Ice Shard chips Camerupt at +1 priority (can't KO from 66% but drops to ~14-44%). Earthquake guarantees Heliolisk KO (81-211% from 75%) and has a chance to KO Camerupt (65-158% from 66%) while being super-effective on both. Excadrill at 154 Speed outruns Mega Camerupt (20-64 Speed) and acts first. Camerupt's Fire/Ground moves are resisted by Excadrill's Ground/Steel typing (0.25x EarthPower, 0.5x HeatWave). Weavile survives Earthquake self-damage (~56% estimated, leaving ~36% HP).
decisions.notebook: Sun team plan intact. Priority trio: Weavile Ice Shard, Scizor Bullet Punch, third priority TBD. Excadrill Focus Sash + Mold Breaker EQ reserved for revenge-killing Mega Camerupt/Mawile. Drought has 2 turns remaining after this turn. Rotom-Wash and Mamoswine still to be revealed. Key fact: Excadrill's Ground/Steel resists Camerupt's Fire/Ground attacks at 0.25-0.5x.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Set Trick Room safely; neither shown single attack KOs Farigiraf. Under Room, Eruption removes Scizor and forces Excadrill to its Focus Sash, preserving the best endgame position against their final unrevealed Pokémon.
Floette-Eternal is the only remaining Pokémon and must enter to continue the game.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 reveals: Charizard-Y established sun and was KOed by Helping Hand Solar Power Thunderbolt. Weavile: Jolly Life Orb Pressure; Ice Shard, Night Slash, Knock Off, Icicle Crash. Excadrill: Jolly Focus Sash Mold Breaker; Earthquake, Iron Head, Rock Slide, Protect; Protect succeeded once then failed consecutively. Scizor: Adamant Expert Belt; Bullet Punch, Bug Buzz, U-turn, Knock Off. Opponent’s unrevealed final bring is one of Rotom-Wash, Mamoswine, or Scizor depending on game. Preserve Armor Tail where possible to deny priority and aim for Trick Room positioning for Mega Camerupt. Floette is key into Rotom-Wash with Energy Ball and can provide Helping Hand.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill Earthquake (2x vs Camerupt-Mega) is our best chance to KO the biggest immediate threat—Camerupt's Eruption OHKOs both our Pokémon. Simultaneously, Scizor's Knock Off hits Farigiraf for 2x and strips Mental Herb. Scizor takes ~50% spread recoil from EQ but survives, giving us a strong tempo if Camerupt falls.
decisions.notebook: Sun team plan intact. Drought 2 turns left. Excadrill Focus Sash + Mold Breaker EQ reserved for revenge-killing Mega Camerupt/Mawile. Rotom-Wash and Mamoswine still to be revealed. Key fact: Excadrill's Ground/Steel resists Camerupt's Fire/Ground at 0.25-0.5x. Camerupt-Mega Eruption OHKOs both Scizor (4x) and Excadrill (2x) under sun—must eliminate Camerupt this turn or switch out. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Intimidate. Prioritize KO on Camerupt-Mega, then pressure Farigiraf.

decisions.rationale: Floette is the last available Pokémon and is guaranteed OHKOed by Scizor’s Technician Expert Belt Bullet Punch before it can act; conceding avoids unnecessary play in a mathematically lost Game 1.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 reveals: Charizard-Y was Timid Charizardite Y with Fire Blast/Solar Beam/Air Slash/Protect and established sun. Weavile was Jolly Life Orb Pressure with Ice Shard/Night Slash/Knock Off/Icicle Crash. Excadrill is Jolly Focus Sash Mold Breaker with Earthquake/Iron Head/Rock Slide/Protect; its Protect succeeded once and then failed on consecutive use. Scizor is Adamant Expert Belt Technician with Bullet Punch/Bug Buzz/U-turn/Knock Off; Bullet Punch cleanly KOs Floette-Eternal. Opponent brought Scizor rather than Rotom-Wash or Mamoswine in Game 1. Preserve Armor Tail in future games to deny Weavile and Scizor priority; establish Trick Room safely for Mega Camerupt. Floette is valuable into Rotom-Wash via Energy Ball and can support with Helping Hand.

decisions.rationale: Bullet Punch (Steel, priority +1) with Technician and STAB is super-effective 2x vs Floette-Eternal and should KO at 100% HP, winning the game outright since all other foes are fainted. Iron Head as Excadrill's backup ensures the KO if Bullet Punch falls short.
decisions.notebook: Sun team plan intact. Drought expired after turn 5. Rotom-Wash and Mamoswine still to be revealed. Key matchup notes: Excadrill Ground/Steel resists Camerupt Fire/Ground. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Intimidate. Need to track opponent's remaining threats for future games.

reflections.summary: Lost despite removing Charizard-Y immediately because switching Farigiraf out let Weavile pressure Camerupt with Ice Shard and left Mega Camerupt facing Excadrill without Trick Room. The Camerupt Mega plan was poorly positioned once Armor Tail and Trick Room support were gone; Floette did not meaningfully cover that endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Against this Charizard-Y/Excadrill lead structure, keep Farigiraf in when Weavile enters, use Armor Tail to deny Ice Shard, and establish Trick Room before bringing in and Mega Evolving Camerupt. Reconsider committing the preview plan to Mega Camerupt if that Trick Room line cannot be protected.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Game 1 structure was Charizard-Y + Mold Breaker Excadrill lead with Life Orb Weavile and Expert Belt Technician Scizor in back; Rotom-Wash and Mamoswine were omitted. Charizard-Y is Timid with Fire Blast/Solar Beam/Air Slash/Protect; Excadrill is Jolly Focus Sash with Earthquake/Iron Head/Rock Slide/Protect; Weavile has Ice Shard and Knock Off; Scizor has Knock Off and priority Bullet Punch. Future plan: preserve Farigiraf against Weavile/Scizor priority and set Trick Room before deploying Mega Camerupt into Excadrill.

reflections.summary: Opponent ran a Trick Room sun team (Farigiraf/Heliolisk/Mega Camerupt/Floette-Eternal). Charizard-Mega-Y was the correct sun abuser but was immediately KO'd by Heliolisk's Thunderbolt into Focus Sash — a predictable trade. The real win condition was Excadrill with Mold Breaker: Earthquake in sun OHKO'd Mega Camerupt and killed Heliolisk, collapsing their entire offensive core before Trick Room could take hold. Scizor cleaned up Farigiraf. Opponent's remaining Floette-Eternal lacked the firepower to threaten through Excadrill/Scizor.
reflections.adjustment: Charizard-Mega-Y is a known liability as lead against a Focus-Sash Heliolisk with Thunderbolt. Next game, lead with Excadrill or Scizor to scout safely and preserve Mega Charizard-Y as a mid-game sun cleaner once the Thunderbolt threat is revealed. Also consider swapping Weavile (which contributed little and died to Thunderbolt) for Mawile — Intimidate helps against their physical attackers (unpicked Tauros/Mawile both run Intimidate), and Sucker Punch covers Trick Room turn attempts.
reflections.notebook: Opponent: Trick Room sun team. Core is Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Mental Herb consumed turn 1 via Helping Hand into Heliolisk), Mega Camerupt, SolarPower Heliolisk, Floette-Eternal. Unpicked: Mawile (Intimidate/Mawilite/Brave) and Tauros-Paldea-Combat (Intimidate/ShucaBerry/Jolly) — both physical, both Intimidate users. Farigiraf used Helping Hand turn 1, signaling full offensive sun commitment. Floette-Eternal (Modest, Flower Veil) is likely their Trick Room cleaner/late-game wincon. Excadrill Mold Breaker Earthquake is the definitive answer to their Fire/Ground core. Next game: lead Excadrill or Scizor, preserve Mega Charizard-Y, consider Mawile over Weavile for Intimidate utility.
